name: Beavis and Butt-Head
description: Two dimwitted teenagers discuss TV, heavy-metal music, nachos, and trying to "score with chicks." When the duo aren't sitting on the couch, they try to pick up girls at the local convenience store, slack off at school, or wreak havoc while working at a burger joint.

videos.title: Frog Baseball
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head play baseball - with a frog. Originally aired on MTV's Liquid Television.

videos.title: Peace, Love & Understanding
videos.overview: Peace, Love and Understanding is the second pilot episode of Beavis and Butt-head, after "Frog Baseball". Like creator Mike Judge's other early short cartoons, it was funded by Spike and Mike and shown on MTV's Liquid Television in the early 1990s. Mike Judge stated in an interview that he heavily disliked this particular episode, along with the season 1 episode "Give blood" which were both conceived on the same day.

videos.title: Door-to-Door
videos.overview: The boys go to door-to-door to collect money for the poor as part of a class project; they meet up with a dominatrix.

videos.title: Give Blood
videos.overview: Mr. Van Driessen sends the boys on a petition drive to stop a furrier from coming to town.

videos.title: Balloon
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head buy helium balloons in order to kill dolphins at a dolphin show.

videos.title: Scientific Stuff
videos.overview: Daria is assigned to help the boys with their science project.

videos.title: Good Credit
videos.overview: The boys have Mr. Anderson's credit card, and buy $6,275 worth of animals at the pet store...which puts a damper on Anderson's Odd Fellows convention.

videos.title: Burger World
videos.overview: Beavis deep fries a mouse and bugs, and Butt-head serves it to Mr. Anderson as a mouse-burger and French flies.

videos.title: Baby Makes Uh, Three
videos.overview: Buzzcut divides the class into boy/girl pairs, and assigns each a ""sugar baby"" which they must care for and nurture for one week.  Beavis and Butt-head are paired together (as each girl in the class has refused to be assigned to them), and promptly give their "baby" a bath -- in a stream.

videos.title: Beware of the Butt
videos.overview: The boys incur the wrath of woman at the drive-in theatre, after taking a picture of her butt.

videos.title: At the Sideshow
videos.overview: The boys go to a carnival sideshow to watch Tiffany The Rubber Band Lady perform.  Somehow, they wind up in their own show, as the "Chicken-Head-Biting, Siamese twin Geeks."

videos.title: Customers Suck
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head deal with annoying customers (and deep fry stuff) during a shift at Burger World.

videos.title: Sick
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head go to the doctor to get prescription medicine, so they can "feel good."

videos.title: Home Improvement
videos.overview: Butthole and Joe paint Mr. Anderson's house. Bored with that, they sniff paint thinner, destroy quite a few things, paint his cat's butt, and decide to go for a nice ride on his lawnmower.

videos.title: Way Down Mexico Way (1)
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head head to Mexico with their friend, Dave, in an effort to obtain illegal fireworks, but instead make a run for the bathroom after a taco stand owner gets revenge on the duo who fed his dog hot sauce.

videos.title: Way Down Mexico Way (2)
videos.overview: During the ride back to the U.S., Dave forces Beavis and Butthead to smuggle pills by swallowing condoms full of them – but the duo forget to tie them up and the three of them end up getting pulled over by border patrol.

videos.title: At the Movies
videos.overview: The boys go to the drive-in theatre, causing trouble in the bathroom, the concession stand and with the security guard.

videos.title: No Laughing (1)
videos.overview: Principal McVicker attempts a radical solution to Beavis and Butt-head's stupidity and continuous laughing in class: they can't laugh at anything they hear for a week.

videos.title: No Laughing (2)
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head struggle to avoid laughing during sexual education class. Problem is, Buzzcut's teaching sex education, and he's not going to make this task easy for them...

videos.title: The Butt-Head Experience
videos.overview: During a shift at Burger World, Butt-head goes to sleep (standing up), and dreams that he and Beavis are rock stars.

videos.title: Lawn & Garden
videos.overview: The boys prune Mr. Anderson's trees...and destroy his house.

videos.title: Stewart's House
videos.overview: The boys go over to Stewart's house to watch "Death Truck" on pay-per-view, but, bored with that, they give him a flying wedgy, vacuum the cat, sniff gas from the stove, and blow up his kitchen.

videos.title: For Better or Verse
videos.overview: The boys must each compose a haiku for their English class.

videos.title: Bedpans & Broomsticks
videos.overview: While doing community service work  at the hospital, the boys steal heart patient Billy Bob's golf cart and wreak further havoc.

videos.title: Babes R Us
videos.overview: Inspired by an American Gladiators episode, Beavis and Butt-head water down the front lawn, don bikini tops, and fight each other with boxing glove-topped baseball bats; they go to "Babes R Us" and try to get tickets to see female mud wrestling.  Being underage, they are beaten senseless by Thor, the bouncer.  Features the classic song, "Diarrhea, Cha Cha Cha."

videos.title: Yogurt's Cool
videos.overview: The boys buy frozen yogurt after seeing a seductive ad for it on TV.

videos.title: Heroes
videos.overview: The boys go skeet shooting and Butt-head downs a jumbo jet.

videos.title: Sign Here
videos.overview: Mr. Van Driessen sends the boys on a petition drive to stop a furrier from coming to town.

videos.title: Washing the Dog
videos.overview: The boys do a favor for Mr. Anderson (who they hope will die soon, and leave his money to them) by washing his dog Collette at the laundromat.  Of course, they wind up in one of the dryers, too.

videos.title: Friday Night
videos.overview: The boys head to Maxi-Mart for some Friday night action; they meet a hot biker chick with larceny on her mind.

videos.title: Be All You Can Be
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head are almost recruited into the Army by Sergeant Dick Leaky, a.k.a. "The Rooster."

videos.title: Comedians
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head decide to become stand-up comedians, perform at a comedy club, get booed and burn the place down.

videos.title: Carwash
videos.overview: Needing money to replace the batteries in their TV remote control, Beavis and Butt-head offer to wash a neighbor's vintage car. They take it for a drive to air dry it, and get into an accident with Mr. Anderson.

videos.title: Couch-Fishing
videos.overview: The boys reel in various things (and people) while casting from the couch, and then get Stewart in trouble with the law.

videos.title: Incognito
videos.overview: After being threatened at school, Beavis and Butt-head wear disguises to class.

videos.title: Kidnapped
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head want to go to a concert so they try to kidnap Stewart for ransom money...but quickly get sick of him.

videos.title: Naked Colony
videos.overview: Without the $4,000 membership fee, Beavis and Butt-head must sneak into Sunny Grove Nudist Colony to see naked people.

videos.title: Tornado
videos.overview: The boys go to a trailer park during a tornado and (almost) get to ""do it"" with Lolita & Tanqueray.

videos.title: Cleaning House
videos.overview: Van Driessen has Beavis and Butt-head clean his house to learn about work and money; instead they learn that 8-track tapes aren't waterproof.

videos.title: Scratch 'N' Win
videos.overview: The boys win the lottery and buy a riding lawn mower.

videos.title: Scared Straight
videos.overview: Placed in a ""Scared Straight"" program at school, the boys visit a prison and thrash with some inmates who like Judas Priest and Iron Maiden.

videos.title: Eating Contest
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head enter a bratwurst eating contest and end up having to feed frogs to earn the entrance fee.

videos.title: Sporting Goods
videos.overview: Buzzcut orders Beavis and Butt-head to buy athletic supporters for gym class; Daria takes a revealing picture of them for the school newspaper.

videos.title: Sperm Bank
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head find a new way to make money.

videos.title: Buff 'N' Stuff
videos.overview: Buzzcut tries to get Beavis and Butt-head to work out.

videos.title: Citizen Butt-head
videos.overview: Principal McVicker gives the boys a pass to keep them away from school during President Clinton's visit, but they end up meeting him and becoming Students of the Year.

videos.title: Politically Correct
videos.overview: The boys watch the touching drama ""Joey Buttawipo: My Story;""  Mr. Van Driessen gives them informational books about getting in touch with their feminine sides; they run for Class Treasurer at school.

videos.title: Ball Breakers
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head want to know what's inside a bowling ball, so they blow one up; Mr. Anderson gets blamed.

videos.title: Beavis and Butt-head Meet God
videos.overview: After seeing hitch-hikers meet a chick on the Late, Late Movie ""Screwing Total Strangers,"" Beavis and Butt-head give it a try.  Sunburned and seeing no chicks, they get into a van and are taken to a religious cult where they meet ""God"" -- a guy named Hank who has a knack for biblical movie quotes and...chick videos.

videos.title: True Crime
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head find an ATM card, get some cash with it and get hunted by the law on TV.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: For throwing eggs at Mr. Anderson's house, Beavis and Butt-head are charged with trespassing and vandalism.  Butt-head, guided by a vision of Doug Llewelyn of "The Pupil's Court," handles their defense.

videos.title: The Crush
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head watch themselves on TV, mooning the camera during a news story about a local disaster; infatuated with a hoodlum named Todd, they take a bumpy ride in the trunk of his car as initiation into his gang.

videos.title: Plate Frisbee
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head play frisbee with an antique plate belonging to Stewart's mom.

videos.title: Canoe
videos.overview: The school psychiatrist requires Beavis, Butt-head and Stewart to go on a canoe trip, led by Mr. Van Driessen.  Butt-head tells Beavis that this is Mr. Van Driessen's attempt at making ""his move"" on Beavis.  A fight ensues, and the boys' canoe capsizes.  While relieving themselves in the woods (wearing only underwear), they get poison ivy.  Mr Van Driessen gets mauled by a bear.

videos.title: Young, Gifted & Crude
videos.overview: The boys accidentally score highly on an IQ test and wind up in the gifted class, where they destroy an actual gifted kid's brain.

videos.title: Foreign Exchange
videos.overview: Mr. Van Driessen picks the boys to chaperone Japanese foreign exchange student Hiroshi "Hiro" Nakayama; they teach him how to hock loogies, play mudball (which causes Mr. Anderson to have a Bataan flashback)...and flog his dolphin.

videos.title: A Very Special Christmas With Beavis and Butt-head
videos.overview: Beavis and Butt-head watch the Yule Log on TV and decide that Christmas is cool.

videos.title: Closing Time
videos.overview: Working the late shift at Burger World, the boys make up some special ""curly fries,"" find new a use for the ceiling fan and have a visit from the health inspector.

videos.title: Most Wanted
videos.overview: The boys meet a tattooed, escaped serial killer who hears voices just like Beavis does.
